project_type: Node 20+/Express 5 + PostgreSQL REST API (MVC) serving vanilla-JS static portals from src/public; JWT in HttpOnly cookie ask_token
language: JavaScript (CommonJS, 'use strict'); front end is plain browser JS, no bundler
build_system: none. npm start = node app.js. No build step. package.json deps: bcryptjs, cookie-parser, dotenv, express 5, express-rate-limit 8, helmet, jsonwebtoken, pg, zod 4. CSP blocks inline handlers and inline scripts.
test_framework: none in the repo (npm test = scripts/placeholder-test.js, must exit 0). Real verification is the harness in .be-tmp/verify/ (PGlite + pglite-socket from %TEMP%\askdb, playwright-core + Edge from %TEMP%\askpw; never add them as repo deps).
build_command: node --check <file> for each edited JS file (no build)
test_command: node .be-tmp/verify/run-all.mjs (all suites + static checks, exit 0). Single suite: start the DB (node .be-tmp/verify/db.mjs in background, wait for .be-tmp/verify/.dbport) then node .be-tmp/verify/<suite>.mjs. Finally: npm ci && npm test -- --runInBand
verification_instructions: 1) edit with read + str_replace/fs_write only. 2) node --check changed files. 3) run the relevant harness suite(s) (each suite resets the DB with database/db.sql + database/seed.sql and spawns its own app via lib.mjs spawnApp, DB_POOL_MAX=1). 4) at the end run run-all.mjs completely. 5) stop the app, PGlite (db.mjs) and any node processes you started.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Screenshots go to .be-tmp/screens/ (overwritten by browser suites). Suite output .out files in .be-tmp/verify/ and run-logs/. Nothing generated is committed.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. NO Postgres server (psql 17 client only): verify on PGlite. Harness runs with DB_POOL_MAX=1 so any pool query inside withTx deadlocks: use the tx client for audit writes. APP_FAKE_TODAY=2026-11-06 vs real clock: some cancel-window fixtures skip near midnight SGT. Never run git add/commit/push/reset/stash/checkout-restore, never change git config, never touch .env (names only), .gitignore, prompts/. No .agents/ in the repo. Never edit source with shell redirection/Set-Content/sed.
contribution_requirements: MVC layering (SQL only in src/models; rules in src/services; thin controllers/routes); parameterised SQL; zod strict validators via middleware/validate.js (req.valid); errors via utils/errors AppError -> { error: { code, message } }; JSON-only mutating requests; role matrix BA vs front desk preserved; no secrets in logs/audit; payments stay mock; QR check-in untouched; seed dates inside 2025-11-06..2027-11-06 except dob and student_profile.joined_on; schema changes additive and db.sql re-runnable; database/README.md kept in sync.
key_patterns: Services: withTx(async tx => ...) from src/config/db.js; every query takes optional last arg db (tx). Ids: nextId(tx, table, col, prefix, width) in src/models/ids.js. Session shape from src/services/accountService.js toSession. Auth middleware src/middleware/auth.js (authenticate re-reads the account every request). Route guards: requireRole / requireAdminType('business') in src/middleware/roles.js; BA-only admin routes use const ba = requireAdminType('business'). Front end: core.js (openModal/closeModal/toast/esc/icon), api.js (ASK.api/get/post/csv, boot, data-then script list), store.js (AUTH/ADMIN/isBA/signOut), portal.js (ADMIN_PAGES, shell, guard, runPage), per-portal data modules expose ASK.load.* / ASK.act.* (admin-data-desk.js, admin-data-business.js). Pages: <body data-portal data-page data-root>, scripts via api.js data-then list. CSV via src/utils/csv.js toCsv; CSV controller pattern in src/controllers/memberController.js exportCsv.
directory_structure: app.js (express app factory); src/{config,middleware,routes(+admin/),controllers,services,models,validators,utils,public}; src/public/{css,js,landingpage,student_portal,instructor_portal,admin_portal}; database/{db.sql,seed.sql,README.md}; .be-tmp/{report.md,plan.md,verify/(harness),screens/,task2/(plan2.md, FEAT files)}; .db-tmp/ older DB-round scripts (agree.mjs, verify.mjs may be stale).
